name: Reference Extravaganza
description: Supercharge Thymer references. Type [[ to reference any line of text inline (search, pick, insert). Set an alias on any reference, page or line, to change what its chip shows without recreating the link. Inline Transclusion: expand a selected reference in place with Cmd/Ctrl+Down (Cmd/Ctrl+Up collapses) — many embeds at once, persisting across reload; a page reference shows an EDITABLE, native-looking property card (pills, icons, native pickers) with a Properties view chooser (All / Filled in / Custom), keyboard-navigable like a native record. Convert a reference ↔ embedded line with Cmd+Ctrl+R. Commands: "Set alias for reference" (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+A), "Convert reference ↔ embedded line", "Collapse all embeds (this page)", "Set Reference Extravaganza shortcuts" (rebind both in-app).
